snippet.title: Opus Castle - Chapters 3-6 | Launch Trailer - Steam, PS4, PS5 and Xbox One/Series S|X
snippet.description:
🏰 ALL CHAPTERS NOW AVAILABLE! 🏰

The final 4 DLCs for OPUS Castle are here!

Unravel the full mystery behind the haunting of Rua Apa with the complete story now at your fingertips.
Each of the last four chapters dives deeper into the lore, the characters, and the chilling events of the little castle.

Whether you're returning to uncover more secrets or stepping into the castle for the first time, now is the perfect time to explore every corner.

🔍 Chapters 3 to 6 – Available Now!

Are you ready to discover the truth?
